subject: SG vendor with India branch: invoicing, GST and PO split
messages:
From: Marina Tan <procurement@aquatech.sg>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@aquatech.sg
Date: 2026-08-22T08:12:00Z
Subject: New supplier intake - AquaTech (SG HQ + IN branch) - tax forms attached

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick onboarding steps. Attached are our Singapore company tax pack and a note about our India branch operations. Quick summary: our HQ is AquaTech Pte Ltd (Singapore) - UEN: 202345678W - and we operate a registered branch in India (AquaTech India LLP) with GSTIN 27ABCDE1234F1Z5. For services delivered to Redwood's India entity, we typically invoice from the India branch and charge GST where applicable; for services supplied to Redwood Singapore or directly to the Singapore contract, we invoice from the SG HQ and charge Singapore GST (if taxable).

Could you confirm:
- Which legal entity should receive the PO for services in scope (SG HQ vs India branch)?
- Any PO line split requirements for goods vs cross-border services?
- Whether Redwood will apply reverse charge / import of services rules if we invoice from the SG HQ to Redwood India?

I attached: AquaTech_Tax_Forms_SG_2026.pdf (company docs) and a short diagram of our invoicing flows. We can also provide a tax opinion from our advisor if that helps.

Thanks,
Marina Tan
Head of Procurement
AquaTech Pte Ltd
attachments: AquaTech_Tax_Forms_SG_2026.pdf

Subject: Re: New supplier intake - AquaTech (SG HQ + IN branch) - tax forms attached

Hi Marina,

Thanks — received the package. A couple of clarifying items so we can set up the vendor record and issue the PO correctly:

1) If you can confirm which legal entity will sign the Redwood contract (SG HQ vs India branch) that will determine our supplier master record.
2) If services are rendered to Redwood India (our INC entity), we typically prefer invoices from an India-registered supplier to avoid reverse-charge complexity on our end. If you must invoice from SG HQ, we will need: your Singapore invoice plus a copy of your India branch registration and TRN so our AP team can assess import-of-services / reverse charge.
3) For the PO, our procurement system can accept split line items (goods vs services). Please confirm if you plan to send combined invoices or separate invoices for goods and services.
4) Please send your India GSTIN, Tax Residency Certificate (if available), and the AP contact for electronic invoicing.

I've attached a draft PO (Draft_PO_12234.pdf) for review. Can you sign and return a signed stub if OK? Once we have the entity selection and TRN we will set the tax handling in the PO.

Looping in Rishi/Mina/Karthik for tax and AP confirmation — can you advise on the recommended treatment if AquaTech invoices from SG HQ to Redwood India?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: Draft_PO_12234.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Marina Tan <procurement@aquatech.sg>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-22T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: New supplier intake - AquaTech (SG HQ + IN branch) - tax forms attached

Thanks Laura — short tax note (we also requested AquaTech's advisor opinion and they shared KPMG_India_GST_Opinion_2026.pdf). Key points: 

- If AquaTech invoices from the India branch (GSTIN provided), treat like a domestic supply: vendor charged GST on their invoice and Redwood India can claim input tax subject to normal recovery rules. No reverse charge.
- If AquaTech invoices from SG HQ directly to Redwood India, India’s import of services rules (reverse charge mechanism - RCM) are likely to apply: Redwood India would need to self-assess GST on the imported service and pay under RCM, subject to specific exemptions. To avoid RCM, vendor invoicing from India branch is preferable.
- Singapore GST: if the supply is to Redwood Singapore and AquaTech invoices from SG HQ, Singapore GST may apply depending on place-of-supply rules; vendor should confirm.
- Withholding tax (WHT): cross-border services may have WHT depending on the nature of services and tax treaties. If AquaTech invoices from SG HQ and Redwood India pays, we'd consider withholding tax unless a tax residency certificate indicates treaty relief. Please provide the tax residency certificate (TRC) if available.

Operational recommendations for PO and AP: 
1) Create two supplier records if AquaTech will transact under both SG HQ and India branch — each with its own legal entity, tax IDs, and AP email.
2) Use separate PO lines for (a) goods/imported hardware, (b) local services (invoice from India branch), (c) cross-border services (if invoiced from SG). This allows correct tax coding and automated RCM tagging.
3) Require the vendor to include these fields on the invoice: supplier legal name, GSTIN/Tax ID, invoice-level PO number, line-level GL code, breakdown of taxable vs non-taxable services, currency, and where applicable TRC reference.
4) If AquaTech cannot invoice from India branch, our AP team will need an early-warning so we can calculate RCM and WHT in our payment runs.

I've attached KPMG_India_GST_Opinion_2026.pdf AquaTech shared — see section 2.2 on imported services. Mina / Karthik, please confirm AP routing and e-invoicing format for Redwood India (we have e-invoice thresholds to consider).

-Rishi
Principal Tax Counsel
attachments: KPMG_India_GST_Opinion_2026.pdf

Subject: Re: New supplier intake - AquaTech (SG HQ + IN branch) - tax forms attached

Hi Laura / Rishi / team,

Thanks for the clear guidance. Confirmations: 
- AquaTech India LLP will be the billing entity for all services delivered to Redwood India. GSTIN: 27ABCDE1234F1Z5. We will invoice Redwood India for local services and include GST where applicable.
- For contracts where Redwood Singapore is the contracting party we will invoice from AquaTech Pte Ltd (SG) and confirm GST separately.
- Attached: signed PO stub (AquaTech_PO_signed_stub.pdf) and a copy of the company TRC for SG and India. We will ensure invoices contain the fields you requested and will split goods vs services on separate invoices where required.

AP contact for India invoices: india.ap@aquatech.in
Format: PDF invoices to india.ap@aquatech.in with PO number in subject; for high-value invoices we can supply e-invoice JSON on request.

Let us know if you want us to include our India branch bank details on the SG PO for visibility; otherwise we will provide bank details on the India invoices.

Regards,
Marina
Head of Procurement
AquaTech Pte Ltd
